Bot: I can see only 2 stars. Is there a mistake in my star maps?
You: I don’t think there’s a mistake.
You: I think I remember someone telling me that in urban areas stars are hardly visible because of the pollution.
Bot: So…{{wi}} These two stars are the only ones that we are going to see?
You: 1 star.
Bot: Huh?
